podcasts.name: Tech Snippets Today with Joseph Raczynski
podcasts.title: Wallets for Humans (and AI Agents): The New Era of Embedded Crypto Infrastructure with Itai Turbahn
podcasts.description: Welcome back to Tech Snippets Today, coming to you live from ETHConf in New York City! We are living through a massive paradigm shift in the digital asset space. The dust is settling on years of regulatory uncertainty in the US, and what’s emerging is a clear, institutional-grade highway for Web3. But as the macro environment opens up, a massive micro problem remains: UX and infrastructure. How do we onboard the next billion users and enterprises without forcing them to write down 12-word seed phrases or decipher complex gas fees? The answer lies in making the blockchain invisible. It lies in embedded wallets and autonomous financial rails. To break this down, I am joined today by Itai Turbahn, the VP of Embedded Wallets at Fireblocks—the enterprise giant securing trillions in digital asset volume. Itai, welcome to the show... Send us Fan Mail Many more amazing technology episodes to come! Subscribe and prepare for the new world. If you would like to join the show, please reach out. For more information, please visit the following: Website: https://www.josephraczynski.com/ Blog: https://JTConsultingMedia.com/ Podcast: https://techsnippetstoday.buzzsprout.com LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/joerazz/ X: https://x.com/joerazz
